text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kinko Sho had finally arrived.
With this race, Still in Love would—
stop running.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: How strange.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't suppress my instincts, I can't give up.
...Even though it was my dream.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Right now... I'm just...
so, so excited for tomorrow.
choice_data_list: (Is it really... coming to an end?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her, the peaceful days she could never have hoped for are finally beginning.
If so, rather than feel disappointed... I want to cheer her on.
choice_data_list: Run your heart out and leave no regrets!
Run your heart out and leave no regrets, okay?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
" 'Don't go.' 'Keep running.'—
I forced myself to swallow down
those surging words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue was enveloped in immense anticipation.
That's because today boasted a star-studded lineup worthy of a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Taaap~~~~~!!
Today's your stage, blow them all away!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Everyone, get on board my ship!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you! A Grand dream!
Come on, rise, rise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First is Tap Dance City.
A captain seeking fortune on the seas of racing.
She's today's most-watched Umamusume. And—

text_block_list.name: Alv's Fan
text_block_list.text:
Groove-saaan!
Don't give up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Alv's Fan
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove, who could be said to have
awakened at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
also carried fervent expectations from a subset of fans.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Here she comes, our Triple Tiara Queen!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I was really looking forward
to hanging out with you—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's this!?
What's with that—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What's with this listless, retired-from-life attitude?!
Are you... really Still in Love?!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The monster inside you...!
That's what I wanna dance with!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"...Tch! Whatever.
You better show me some backbone in the race, got it?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So you've steeled your resolve for that path.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Then never mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —The one who will be remembered by future generations is me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...It doesn't matter.
Even if everyone forgets me, it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"If only I could stay by the side of my beloved's heart...
forever and ever――"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That's happiness...
